expectedVisualScoreImpact: Score validity: prevents future source/config drift from reallocating points or lowering a hard minimum while still summing to 100.
Critical-fail validity: prevents removal, substitution, duplication or renaming of any of the twelve automatic-fail conditions before scoring.

No direct visual points are expected from this run; the change protects the meaning of a future >=92/100 result rather than self-awarding appearance improvements without pixels.
